label: BTHome → Victron
info: Generic unencrypted BTHome v2 BLE sensor bridge for Venus OS.

name: Decode BTHome v2
Map to Victron Virtual Sensor
func: const p=msg.payload||{}; const out={}; if(Number.isFinite(Number(p.temperature))) out["/Temperature"]=Number(p.temperature); if(Number.isFinite(Number(p.humidity))) out["/Humidity"]=Number(p.humidity); if(Number.isFinite(Number(p.battery_voltage))) out["/BatteryVoltage"]=Number(p.battery_voltage); msg.payload=out; return Object.keys(out).length?msg:null;
